info.name: NISPL Cloud Tech - Enterprise Backend API Collection
info.description:
Complete Postman API Collection for Net Infotech System (NISPL) Enterprise Backend.
Includes all endpoints for Authentication, Customer Management, Contracts, Invoices & Payments, Products Catalog, Staff RBAC, Audit Trails, Notifications, Cart Commerce, and Dashboard Telemetry.

variable.description: Base API Server URL (e.g., http://localhost:4000 or production https://website-ebxf.onrender.com)
JWT Bearer Access Token (automatically populated after executing Login or Register request)
Client session identifier for Cart operations
Active customer record identifier or Mongo ID
Active contract agreement identifier or Mongo ID
Payment / invoice identifier or Mongo ID

item.name: 1. System & Health
item.description: Health checks and backend runtime telemetry.

request.description: Returns backend runtime status, environment info, and top-level endpoints summary.
Standard liveness check used by cloud orchestrators and monitoring probes.
Root-level health check endpoint.

request.description: Inspects whether a primary administrator has already been provisioned and returns the configured administrator email address.
Dispatches a 6-digit one-time verification password to the authorized administrator inbox.
Verifies the email OTP and creates the primary administrator credentials.
